title: Warm-handoff email adds an undisclosed sentence beyond the pinned copy
evidence: "Their contact details and the same log are on the application page. If they complete the form anyway, it still shows up there.",
detail: Spec pins the body as "+ `Their contact details and the same log are on the application page.` + CTA `Open the application`". The appended "If they complete the form anyway..." sentence is not in the pinned copy, not one of the three documented deviations, and absent from the dev record's spec-to-implementation delta list (which pruned an extra co-nudge line for exactly this contract).
recommended_fix: Either drop the sentence to match the pinned string, or add it to the spec's deviations register and pin it with a test so the copy contract stays honest.

title: Warm-handoff count line says "tried to reach them" where the spec pinned "messaged them"
detail: Spec pinned copy: "We've messaged them {attempt_count} times over the last 4 days. The attempt log:". The Verify clause requires "copy matches the pinned strings in this spec". The change is disclosed in the dev record ("Spec-to-implementation deltas (review-visible): (1) warm-handoff copy says 'We've tried to reach them {n} times' (spec pinned 'messaged them')") with a rationale, so this is a review-visible deviation, not a hidden one.
recommended_fix: Accept the disclosed delta and update the spec's pinned copy, or revert the string to "We've messaged them " to match the pin.
